entries.title: Protein Homology Detection Using Protein Language Model Embeddings
entries.description: Developed a fine-tuned protein language model embedding approach with contrastive learning, improving detection accuracy over BLAST and enabling scalable search with a 5× speedup using FAISS.

entries.title: Bridging AR and Physical Actuation for a Home Storage Device
entries.description: Built MagicStorage, a prototype combining AR glasses, a robotic arm, and vision-language models to identify, store, and retrieve household items using visual and voice commands. Won Senior Independent Work Prize. Honestly, I just had fun messing around with a lot of cool tech!

Python, JavaScript, Java, C/C++, Assembly, SQL, HTML/CSS, R, MATLAB, Swift.
